subject: LAB-029
check: Audio Workshop domain and native manual-rendering adapter regression

provenance.sourceRevision: e35785c; Audio Workshop package unchanged throughout LAB-029-B

outcome.detail: 71 tests in 8 suites passed. Original loop determinism, smoothing, non-finite and oversized calls, hostile presets/MIDI/WAVE files, invalid lengths, render/save cancellation, model-tool denial, duplicate save receipt, archived collection refusal, manual-rendering rate recovery/fade/mute/bypass retention and failed recovery fallback, interruption injection, real in-process plugin state reload and damaged-state retention all passed.

limitations: Fixture path on Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0 (26A425), Swift 6.4. No physical device or realtime output opened.
Route/rate and interruption events are injected into a real manual-rendering engine; no system output-route event observed. Plugin is registered in-process, not the AUv3 extension.
No hardware MIDI client, runtime allocation trace, manual accessibility pass, or system file dialog. Authorization/store cases use the in-memory operation backend.
